name: country
purpose: the player's country, 1..128

name: age
purpose: age (22..37 at a new game); the player screen shows it; incremented once per displayed year by the yearly loop 1771:7E4A (7E6F, wraps at 255)

name: peak_age
purpose: the peak age: +4 equals +3 while +1 lies in +2-1 .. +2+3 (1771:32EB: the copy branch +2..+2+3, and k = 0 at +2-1), the retirement test 1771:7F40 also reads it (aged +1 > +2+5 retires); drawn once at creation by roll_peak_age 1771:3291 (25..29 outfield, 28..32 goalkeeper) and never moved afterwards; not shown on the player screen

name: rating
purpose: the country's rating (1771:10E7) + 0x7F at creation, the player's ceiling (inferred potential, about 70%)

name: ability
purpose: current ability (the reading, about 85%): the yearly loop recomputes it from +1/+2/+3 by 1771:32EB (the copy branch +2..+2+3 holds the ceiling +3; below it +3*(0x10-((+2 - +1) idiv 2)) div 16, the ceiling too at +2 - 1, so the maximum spans five ages; above it one step of +3/16 per year down to 0 at +2+19, past which the 16-bit factor wraps and the stored low byte is no longer monotone); the scale of all twelve skill bars

name: skill_profile
purpose: the skill profile 1..16: how steep the twelve skills' curve is; also feeds hardness, leadership and two-footed

name: position
purpose: the position code (0 the goalkeeper), shown as position; the mark row and the name colour read it. +6 = +7 in a new game, so which shown cell each feeds is static only

name: club_position
purpose: the position code too, shown as club position; written first, then copied to +6; feeds height, foot and the skills

name: caps
purpose: caps, a 16-bit word (0 in a new game; values beyond 0 static only); the retirement test 1771:7F40 reads it (== 0 with age past DS:110E[gk] retires a computer-country player)

name: scorer_count
purpose: the player's goal count for the top-scorers tables at [DS:A93F] (three 16-byte entries per table: the initial, the name, the count word +0xC, the player index +0xE): 0791:B3B7 increments it per goal (B3EC) and reads it into or against the table (B446, B53B, B5E4); the yearly loop's 1771:7FB1 clears it (7FD4) at every ageing stage, so the count is per displayed year

name: goals
purpose: goals, a 16-bit word (0 in a new game; values beyond 0 static only)

name: morale
purpose: player confidence/form: B364 clamps each result/bench/pool/scorer call to 1..32; 7CC5 live match writes can exceed 32 and optionally update saved form; screen word DS:78A3[min(+0x0C,32)] and bar below 32

name: fitness
purpose: fitness: 42BC's y=20 word/bar uses +D unless +E=0 (injured); persistent baseline updated by 3558/3651 and copied to positive energy by CB7D; match decrement tails do not write it

name: energy
purpose: energy: 42BC's y=21 word/bar uses +E; watched activity and quick five-minute slot tails decrement it only while signed >1; 0 is injury, signed <1 unavailable; CB7D copies fitness into signed-positive energy, 3651 restores it after fitness update or the healing draw

name: own_tactic_set
purpose: the player's own tactic set (Pascal set, element k at bit k-1): for i = 1..4, element i+4 set says the player has his own setting for tactic i and element i is that setting; with element i+4 clear, and for i = 5..8 (no per-player override), the country's default_team_tactic_set element i applies

name: status
purpose: status bits: cards (bits 3..5), suspended or sent off (bits 6, 8: name colour 5), "Protect zone" (bit 7); static only, none set in a new game

name: performance
purpose: performance: 0x7FFF blank, else the raw rating (a starter 0x37; +0x2710 flags an incoming substitute's word, readers strip it when the signed word is above 5000); every commentary line adds s8(DS:0x720[template]) to it

name: squad
purpose: the 20 player indices (into the player array) of the country's squad, in the squad list's order

name: continent_rank
purpose: rank in its continent, one of the three rating inputs

name: world_rank
purpose: world rank, one of the three rating inputs

name: continent
purpose: the continent, one of the three rating inputs; also picks the name colour DS:6905[+0x2C]

name: default_team_tactic_set
purpose: R008, the country's default team tactic set (Pascal set, element k at bit k-1): 1 position (stay back/push forward), 2 possession (keep ball/quick pass), 3 passing (short passes/long passes), 4 tackling (avoid injury/go in hard), 5 (half pitch/full pitch), 6 (sag back to box/stand ground), 7 (play safe/offside trap), 8 mark (zonal/man to man); written from R008 at a new game by 1771:9A40, put back to R008 by 0791:BBFF; a player's own_tactic_set overrides its elements 1..4

name: manager
purpose: 0x80 + the manager's number when a human manages the country (1771:0B77: managed when > 0x80)

name: x
purpose: the record's column; with +1 the position word 2CEC compares with the ball's DS:82F6

name: y
purpose: the record's row; times the side's attack direction (2BE5) measures advancement, 8CF5's compare

name: side
purpose: the record's side/address slot (a260 re-derives it; 2974 reads it, < 0x0C selects side 1)

name: player_index
purpose: the player record index this slot holds (2956 and 9A32 read it as a word)

name: run_direction
purpose: 8889's run direction (1 or 2 by the x sign, else 3 or 4 by y; 8A26/8A79 write it)

name: state
purpose: the state byte 8AE9's handler dispatches on and 6188 tests (13 = walking off; 65A4's kick-off states 5, 6)

name: activity
purpose: active-update counter: A2E6 resets it; 8AE9 adds one when unsigned run_direction <5; with DS:8325 nonzero and unsigned counter >180 it decrements player energy only if signed >1 and always resets the counter; not a quick-mode flag or role weight

name: x
purpose: the ball's column (DS:82F6, read by 9119 and 2CEC)

name: y
purpose: the ball's row (DS:82F7, the sign 9119 and 9564 branch on)

name: vel_x
purpose: the x velocity (DS:82FC; 83A2 adds it, 59B3 negates it on a woodwork bounce)

name: vel_y
purpose: the y velocity (DS:82FE)

name: timer
purpose: the movement timer at DS:8300: nonzero is a moving ball (59B3), and 9564's per-slot gate compares each threshold byte with it

name: row
purpose: the sprite's row (9119 moves it by DS:7920's sign)

name: column
purpose: the sprite's column

name: glyph
purpose: the glyph word drawn into the screen buffer at row*0xA0 + 2*column (9119: 91B1)

name: target_row
purpose: the row the sprite moves toward

name: target_column
purpose: the column the sprite moves toward (rand(2)-based, the per-tick draw)

name: keeping_extra
purpose: added by 278A to the element-1 (keeping) contest value under ball-event code 0x18 (the set CS:276A); what writes it was not traced
